bc_timeline_pressure.definition: Pressure that comes from a deadline somebody else has set.
bc_timeline_pressure.example: The timeline pressure came from the family, not from her body.

equilibrium.definition: A dynamic state in which the forward and reverse rates are equal.
equilibrium.example: At equilibrium, the concentrations stay constant.

gem_impulsivity.definition: The leaning towards acting before you have looked at what the act will do.
gem_impulsivity.example: The message went out in impatience, and the impulsivity cost him the job.

kpar_exception.definition: The case in which a rule does not hold, and the rule is not wrong.
kpar_exception.example: The exception is written under the rule: never on a seized bolt.
